content: {"episode_id":"ep-05025","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1), occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting. Because these events are intermittent, continuous outpatient monitoring is the appropriate means of documenting the rhythm at the time of symptoms. We therefore request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial and payment of the outstanding balance of 702.81."}
